config.rationale: Final evaluation on a fixed custom distribution selected during development; all zeros and failures retained, no input or implementation changes
config.weights_priority: Exactly six uniformly sampled jobs of30 have weight10; others1
config.due_dates: release + ceil(TF times own processing sum); exact rational TF3/2,7/4,2
config.provenance: LiSA handbook p70 equations7.1/7.2 motivate time formulas; other parameters are custom design

gate.interpretation: Development gate only, not a statistical reliability or superiority claim

development_audit.scope: Development only; no final-test or superiority claim

config.primary: Mean of 30 instance-level H values, each averaging nine cross-repetition comparisons. Valid beats failure; both failed tie; lower objective wins.
config.decision: Primary advantage only if two-sided95% stratified instance bootstrap lower bound for H is greater than zero AND candidate valid count >= comparator valid count. Otherwise not established.
config.secondary: Mean (mean E - mean V)/max(1,mean E,mean V). Full-sample numeric analysis only if all180 executions valid; otherwise conditional descriptive comparisons only.
config.failure_policy: Solver failure has no retry. Host/runner interruption or unresolved semantics stops this evaluation and retains every attempt. No automatic replacements; any continuation requires documented review before a completion claim.
config.masking: Do not feed intermediate scores to Sagent or change the frozen solvers, input plan, schedule or analysis. Trackinizer stores progress and file commitments until completion. Shared host filesystem is not an access-control boundary.
config.host_concurrency: Sagent continues separately; one CPU quota does not isolate the host
config.timing_claim: Equal external deadlines and nominal internal requests, not equal CPU work
config.claim_scope: This custom distribution and these frozen implementations under emulation; not algorithmic novelty, optimality, current SOTA or a FrontierOR-wide result
